text: dsh-tool-hackernews 是一款面向 DSH 智能体的 Hacker News 工具插件，通过 Cordis 工具注册接口提供热门故事、关键词搜索和单帖评论详情。热门列表会展示标题、链接、分数、评论数、作者和时间；搜索可按 story、comment、poll、Ask HN 或 Show HN 标签及最近时段筛选；详情可返回帖子内容与有上限的评论树。工具支持设置结果数量、评论数量和请求超时，输出为便于智能体阅读的文本。适合需要查询开发社区动态或追踪讨论的场景。它通过 Algolia HN API 获取数据，不需要 API Key。

dsh-tool-hackernews adds Hacker News tools to DSH: a front-page list, filtered search, and story details with bounded comments. Results include links, available scores, authors, and comment counts. Output limits and request timeout are configurable. It uses the Algolia HN API without an API key.
想快速看看 Hacker News 现在首页有哪些热门技术故事。
帮我按关键词找 Hacker News 上讨论某个技术主题的帖子。
能不能筛出最近一天里 Hacker News 关于某个话题的内容？
我想读一篇 HN 帖子和它下面的主要评论。
让 DSH 搜索 Ask HN 或 Show HN 这类特定标签的故事。
Show me the current Hacker News front page with scores and authors.
Find Hacker News discussions matching a query from the past few hours.
Fetch a Hacker News post and a limited, readable tree of its comments.
dsh-tool-hackernews 的功能「热门故事」：调用 hn_top_stories 获取当前首页故事，可传条数上限，返回标题、链接、分数、评论数与作者。
dsh-tool-hackernews 的功能「关键词搜索」：调用 hn_search 输入查询词，可选择内容标签、时间范围和结果上限，返回匹配故事及其链接、分数、评论数和作者。
dsh-tool-hackernews 的功能「帖子与评论」：调用 hn_item 并提供帖子数字 ID，可读取故事详情和评论树；评论会去除 HTML 并按层级展示，数量可设上限。
dsh-tool-hackernews 使用前须知：搜索词、标签和时间筛选会作为请求参数发送到 hn.algolia.com；工具不要求 API Key。

dsh-tool-hackernews 提供工具 hn_top_stories：Get the current top stories on Hacker News (front page). Use it to answer what is trending in the developer/tech world right now. Returns a numbered list with titles, links, scores, comment counts, and authors.

dsh-tool-hackernews 提供工具 hn_search：Search Hacker News stories by keyword. Returns matching stories with links, scores, comment counts, and authors. Optionally restrict to the last N hours or to a specific tag (e.g. Ask HN / Show HN).
dsh-tool-hackernews 提供工具 hn_item：Get one Hacker News story (by numeric item id) with its top comments. Comment output is bounded to protect context; increase max_comments to see more.

dsh-tool-hackernews README · dsh-tool-hackernews：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Hacker News tool suite for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) agents: `hn_top_stories`, `hn_search`, and `hn_item`. Built on the free [Algolia HN search API](https://hn.algolia.com/api) — **no API key required**.

dsh-tool-hackernews README · Tools：| Tool | Args | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `hn_top_stories` | `limit` (optional, 1–30) | The current Hacker News front page: titles, links, scores, comment counts, authors, relative times. |
| `hn_search` | `query` (required), `tag` (story/comment/poll/ask_hn/show_hn), `since_hours` (1–8760), `limit` (1–30) | Keyword search over HN, optionally restricted to a tag or to the last N hours. |
| `hn_item` | `id` (required), `max_comments` (0–100) | One story with a bounded top-level comment tree (HTML stripped, depth-indented) so context stays safe. |

dsh-tool-hackernews README · Tools：All three tools are **read-only and concurrency-safe**, so DSH may schedule sibling calls in parallel. Each request carries the deployment's cooperative timeout budget and forwards the caller's `AbortSignal`.

dsh-tool-hackernews README · Install：DSH plugins install into a profile via `dsh plugin` (pnpm under the hood). From this GitHub repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add "github:tanf1ng/dsh-tool-hackernews"
```

Or from a local checkout with pnpm:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build

dsh-tool-hackernews README · then in the profile that should load it:：dsh plugin --profile <name> add "file:../../dsh-tool-hackernews"
```

Enable the plugin in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or a product bundle):

```yaml
- id: tool-hackernews
  name: dsh-tool-hackernews
```

dsh-tool-hackernews README · Config：All keys optional:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `registerTopStories` | `true` | Register `hn_top_stories`. |
| `registerSearch` | `true` | Register `hn_search`. |
| `registerItem` | `true` | Register `hn_item`. |
| `topStoriesLimit` | `10` | Default result bound for `hn_top_stories`. |
| `searchLimit` | `8` | Default result bound for `hn_search`. |
| `maxComments` | `20` | Default comment bound for `hn_item`. |
| `fetchTimeoutMs` | `15000` | Per-request timeout budget (ms). |

dsh-tool-hackernews README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build     # tsc -> lib/
pnpm test      # smoke test against a stub fetch (no network needed)
```

The package follows the official DSH tool-plugin pattern: a Cordis plugin (`name` / `inject` / `Config` / `apply`) that registers `defineTool` definitions on `ctx.tools`, with full parameter schemas, canonical output schemas, text renderers, and `presentCall` UI cards.
